items.title: Entire: a Git forge built for agent–human collaboration
items.summary: Launched on October 26, 2026, Entire is an independent Git hosting platform designed around agent–human collaboration, replacing the traditional pull request flow with a mechanism it calls Trails.

items.title: Hob: an offline desktop assistant running open models locally
items.summary: An MIT-licensed desktop assistant built to run open models entirely on your own machine, offline. Launched on Product Hunt on October 26, 2026.

items.title: Pi-Esp Jarvis: a local voice assistant on a Raspberry Pi + ESP32 screen
items.summary: A local voice assistant built from a Raspberry Pi and a small ESP32 display — voice interaction and display handled entirely on local hardware, a low-cost pattern for a home voice terminal.
